title: Afterglow Film Studio
description: A woman in a blue jumpsuit with 'AFTERGLOW' patches sits in a director's chair holding a film reel and a teacup. A translucent ghostly figure of the same woman stands behind her gesturing toward a wall with glowing 'AFTERGLOW' text, surrounded by giant mushrooms, film equipment, and movie posters in a derelict arched room with a broken skylight.
prompt: A woman wearing a blue jumpsuit with glowing patches sits in an old director's chair inside a decaying arched studio with a broken glass skylight. She holds a film reel in one hand and a teacup in the other. A translucent ghostly version of herself stands behind her gesturing at a large glowing 'AFTERGLOW' sign on the wall. Giant mushrooms grow throughout the room, old film reels and movie posters are scattered on the floor and walls, cinematic lighting with purple and teal tones, surreal atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
